repos.description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EMgGbDceNQ and follow here for daily tips and tricks: https://x.com/Scrapling_dev
repos.summary_zh: Scrapling 是一个自适应网页抓取框架，能够处理从单请求到大规模爬取的全场景需求。其核心亮点在于智能解析器可学习网站变化并自动重定位元素，内置绕过 Cloudflare 等反爬系统的能力，支持并发多会话爬取、自动代理轮换和暂停恢复功能。提供实时统计、CLI 和 MCP 服务器集成，是现代 Web 数据采集的高效解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Scrapling is an adaptive web scraping framework designed to handle everything from simple single requests to complex large-scale crawling operations. Its standout feature is an intelligent parser that learns from website changes and automatically relocates elements when pages update. The framework includes built-in anti-bot bypass capabilities that defeat systems like Cloudflare Turnstile out of the box. It enables concurrent multi-session crawling with automatic proxy rotation, pause/resume functionality, and real-time streaming statistics. With integrated CLI tools and an MCP server, Scrapling offers a powerful yet straightforward solution for modern web data extraction at any scale.

repos.description: The web framework for content-driven websites.
repos.summary_zh: Astro 是内容驱动网站的 Web 框架，强调服务端渲染与轻量输出。通过岛屿架构实现交互优化，支持 React 等框架集成和 Markdown 内容集合。默认零 JavaScript，具备快速构建、视图过渡和多平台部署功能。适用于博客、文档站点等内容应用，提供卓越性能与灵活扩展性。
repos.summary_en: Astro is a web framework optimized for content-driven websites, delivering powerful developer experience alongside lightweight output. It uses server-first rendering and the islands architecture for selective interactivity and minimal JavaScript. Astro supports integrations with React, Vue, Svelte and other frameworks, along with Markdown content collections. Features include zero JS by default, view transitions, optimized images, and deployment adapters. It excels in building blogs, documentation sites, and marketing pages with fast builds and excellent performance.

repos.description: "Vibe-Trading: Your Personal Trading Agent"
repos.summary_zh: Vibe-Trading 是港大开源的个人AI交易代理系统，通过单一命令赋予智能体完整交易能力。采用Python 3.11+与FastAPI后端、React 19前端，支持MCP协议实现模型交互。核心亮点包括Swarm集群容错恢复、影子账户模拟交易、Rich交互式CLI。提供API与MCP服务，支持实时任务协调与状态管理，为量化交易提供开箱即用的AI解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Vibe-Trading is HKU's open-source personal AI trading agent system that empowers agents with comprehensive trading capabilities through a single command. Built with Python 3.11+ and FastAPI backend, React 19 frontend, it supports MCP for model context interaction. Key features include Swarm cluster fault tolerance recovery, shadow account simulation, Rich interactive CLI, and automated operations. It provides API and MCP services, enabling real-time task coordination and state management for quantitative trading with out-of-the-box AI solutions.

repos.description: The most intuitive desktop API client. Organize and execute REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, Server Sent Events, and gRPC 🦬
repos.summary_zh: Yaak 是一款隐私优先的跨平台桌面 API 客户端，全面支持 REST、GraphQL、WebSocket、SSE 和 gRPC 协议。基于 Tauri 框架构建，后端采用 Rust 实现高性能与安全性，前端使用 React 提供流畅交互。通过社区许可模式运营，为开发者提供直观、高效的 API 调试与管理解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Yaak is a privacy-first cross-platform desktop API client supporting REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, SSE, and gRPC protocols. Built on Tauri framework with Rust backend and React frontend, it delivers high-performance API debugging experience. Community-funded through license purchases, it offers intuitive interface for developers to organize, test, and manage APIs efficiently.

repos.description: FastAPI Best Practices and Conventions we used at our startup
repos.summary_zh: 初创公司生产环境沉淀的 FastAPI 开发规范，提供领域驱动的项目结构、Pydantic 深度使用策略、异步依赖注入优化方案，以及数据库约定、测试策略等实战指南。专为中大型单体应用设计，帮助团队建立一致、可扩展的 API 开发体系，规避架构陷阱。
repos.summary_en: Production-tested FastAPI development conventions from a startup, offering domain-driven project structure, in-depth Pydantic usage strategies, async dependency injection optimization, and practical guidelines for database conventions and testing. Designed for medium-to-large monolithic applications, it helps teams build consistent, scalable API systems while avoiding architectural pitfalls.

repos.description: Multi-account API gateway for Grok Build, Grok Web, and Grok Console
repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastAPI 构建的 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持流式对话、函数工具调用及文生图/视频功能。提供多账号池管理、额度同步和 Anthropic 协议兼容，内置 Admin 后台与 Web Chat 界面，支持 Docker/Vercel 部署，实现企业级 AI 能力统一管理。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based gateway that converts Grok Web capabilities into OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling seamless integration with existing LLM applications. It supports streaming/non-streaming conversations, function tool calls, and text/image-to-video generation. Key features include multi-account pool management, quota synchronization, Anthropic protocol compatibility, and local media caching. The solution provides a comprehensive Admin backend and Web UI for management, supporting Docker, Vercel, and Render deployment for unified enterprise AI infrastructure.

repos.description: ⚠️ Browser fingerprinting via favicon!
repos.summary_zh: Supercookie 通过 favicon 缓存机制实现浏览器持久指纹追踪，为访客分配独特且难以清除的 ID。该 ID 在隐身模式、清除缓存、重启系统或使用 VPN/AdBlocker 后仍有效。项目仅用于教育演示，旨在揭示 favicon 跟踪的隐私风险。技术亮点包括跨会话持久性、实时 API 演示及 Node.js/Docker 部署，适用于隐私安全研究与开发者警示。
repos.summary_en: Supercookie demonstrates persistent browser fingerprinting via favicon caching, assigning unique, hard-to-clear IDs to visitors. The ID survives incognito mode, cache clears, browser restarts, VPNs, and ad blockers. Built for educational purposes only, it highlights privacy risks from favicon tracking. Key features include cross-session persistence, live demo APIs, and easy deployment with Node.js and Docker, ideal for security research and awareness.

repos.description: Image Hosting solution, Flickr/imgur alternative, make it easy for users to share their images. Using Cloudflare Pages and Telegraph.
repos.summary_zh: Telegraph-Image 是基于 Cloudflare Pages 和 Telegram Channel 的免费图床方案，替代 Flickr/imgur。核心价值：无限存储（单图5MB限制）、零服务器成本、自动绑定 pages.dev 域名或自定义域名。技术亮点包括可选 AI 图片审查、后台管理（网格/瀑布流视图）、批量删除与分页功能，完全依赖 Cloudflare 免费额度运营。
repos.summary_en: Telegraph-Image is a free image hosting solution using Cloudflare Pages and Telegram Channel as a Flickr/imgur alternative. Key value: unlimited storage (5MB/image cap), zero server cost, automatic *.pages.dev domain or custom domain binding. Technical highlights include optional AI image moderation, backend management (grid/waterfall views), batch operations, and full operation within Cloudflare's free tier limits.

repos.description: Bitwarden-compatible server running on Cloudflare Workers
repos.summary_zh: NodeWarden 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的第三方 Bitwarden 兼容服务端，实现零成本自托管密码管理。支持多用户、附件存储、TOTP 及 Passkey 等核心功能，兼容全平台官方客户端。利用 R2/KV 存储保障数据安全，适合个人及小团队私有化部署，规避企业版订阅费用。
repos.summary_en: NodeWarden is a third-party Bitwarden-compatible server deployed on Cloudflare Workers, enabling zero-cost self-hosted password management. It supports multi-user access, attachments, TOTP, and Passkey features while maintaining full compatibility with official clients across platforms. Leveraging R2/KV storage for data security, it's ideal for individuals and small teams seeking private deployment without enterprise subscription fees.

repos.description: Open-source GEO content engineering and multi-site distribution platform with AI quality inspection, illustrated admin help, hosted sites, browser-assisted publishing, and signed updates.
repos.summary_zh: GEOFlow 是开源的 GEO 内容工程与多站点分发系统，通过 AI 生成、RAG 知识库、素材管理和任务自动化，实现可信内容资产的全链路管理。支持多模型调用、智能审核、SEO 优化和静态页面分发，适用于大规模内容生产与多渠道发布场景。基于 Laravel 和 pgvector，提供 Docker 一键部署方案。
repos.summary_en: GEOFlow is an open-source GEO content engineering and multi-site distribution system that orchestrates AI generation, RAG knowledge bases, material management, and task automation into a sustainable workflow. It enables teams to transform trusted resources into manageable, publishable, and trackable content assets across multiple channels. Key features include multi-model AI integration, intelligent review, SEO optimization, static page generation, and analytics. Built on Laravel with PostgreSQL and pgvector, it offers Docker Compose deployment for scalable content operations.

repos.description: The RethinkDNS resolver that deploys to Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly, and Fly.io
repos.summary_zh: Serverless-dns 是一个自托管的无服务器 DNS 解析器，提供类似 Pi-Hole 的内容过滤功能，支持 DNS-over-HTTPS 和 DNS-over-TLS。它可一键部署到 Cloudflare Workers、Deno Deploy、Fastly 和 Fly.io 等边缘平台，利用其免费层即可满足10-20台设备的日常需求。服务器处理延迟仅0-2毫秒，端到端延迟中位数为10-30毫秒，具备全球覆盖能力。
repos.summary_en: Serverless-dns is a self-hosted, serverless DNS resolver with Pi-Hole-like content blocking, supporting DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) and DNS-over-TLS (DoT). It deploys effortlessly to edge platforms including Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly, and Fly.io. The free tiers suffice for 10-20 devices monthly. Server processing takes 0-2ms, with end-to-end latency of 10-30ms (median), enabling global low-latency DNS resolution.

repos.description: An index & manager of Onedrive based on serverless. Can be deployed to Vercel/Heroku/SCF/FG/FC/CFC/PHP web hosting/VPS.
repos.summary_zh: 一个基于Serverless架构的Onedrive文件管理器，支持Vercel、Heroku及国内云函数平台部署。通过生成直链实现用户直传直下载，大幅节省服务器带宽成本。提供可视化文件管理界面，支持多用户、多目录，适用于个人云盘分享、团队文档协作及静态资源托管场景。
repos.summary_en: A serverless-based OneDrive index and manager that enables seamless deployment across Vercel, Heroku, and major Chinese cloud function platforms including Tencent SCF, Huawei FG, Alibaba FC, and Baidu CFC. The system generates direct URLs allowing end-users to upload and download files directly through Microsoft's infrastructure, minimizing server bandwidth consumption to near zero. With an intuitive web interface supporting multi-user access and directory management, it transforms OneDrive into a fully functional cloud storage portal suitable for personal file sharing, team collaboration, and static website hosting. Its PHP implementation ensures broad compatibility with various hosting environments while maintaining low operational costs.

repos.description: ✦ Gemini ➜ OpenAI API proxy. Serverless!
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个OpenAI API格式的代理，将请求转发至Google Gemini API。利用Gemini免费层的慷慨额度，让仅支持OpenAI接口的开发者工具无缝切换至Gemini模型。支持Vercel、Netlify、Cloudflare Workers等Serverless平台一键部署，无需服务器维护，同时提供Node、Deno、Bun本地运行方案，突破地域限制。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a serverless proxy that translates OpenAI API requests to Google Gemini API format. By leveraging Gemini's generous free tier, it enables developers to use OpenAI-exclusive tools with Gemini models at zero cost. Supports one-click deployment to Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, and Deno Deploy without server maintenance. Offers local development via Node, Deno, or Bun, allowing users outside supported regions to obtain API keys via VPN and access Gemini's powerful models seamlessly.

repos.description: 提升部署在cloudflare、vercel或netlify的网页在中国的访问速度和稳定性   cf优选域名 | cf优选ip | cloudflare | vercel | netlify | 加速 | 国内 | 中国 | 境内 | 大陆
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过自定义CNAME解析，优化Cloudflare、Vercel和Netlify服务在中国大陆的访问体验。核心机制是定时测试各平台IP的速度与稳定性，优选出最佳节点并配置三网解析，将国内流量引导至最优线路，海外使用官方IP。相比官方Anycast常将流量路由至东南亚导致拥堵，此方案能有效改善晚高峰时段的访问速度和连通性稳定性，仅需修改DNS记录即可实现，特别适合部署在海外FaaS平台的中文网站加速。
repos.summary_en: This project enhances access speed and stability for websites hosted on Cloudflare, Vercel, or Netlify in mainland China through custom CNAME redirection. It automatically tests IPs from these platforms every 40 minutes, selecting optimal nodes for China's three major ISPs while using official IPs overseas. By bypassing problematic anycast routing that often directs Chinese traffic to Southeast Asia, it significantly improves connectivity during peak hours and prevents single-point failures. The solution requires only DNS configuration changes, making it ideal for accelerating Chinese access to overseas serverless deployments.

repos.description: A high-performance ASCII video rendering engine featuring real-time WebSocket binary streaming and an isolated compiler for serverless static generation. Built for low-latency 30 FPS playback on HTML5 Canvas.
repos.summary_zh: ASCILINE是一款高性能跨平台实时ASCII视频渲染引擎，通过WebSocket二进制帧流传输至HTML5 Canvas，实现超低延迟30FPS播放。核心价值在于将视频像素映射为纯文本画布，支持实时CSS滤镜、低带宽零GPU运行及轻量LLM的AI语义处理。采用Python/FastAPI后端结合OpenCV和NumPy解码映射，支持多色彩模式、自适应编解码、音频同步、播放列表及YouTube/摄像头流。适用于低资源设备、交互式网页媒体交付和嵌入式场景，无需传统视频标签。
repos.summary_en: ASCILINE is a high-performance, cross-platform real-time ASCII video rendering engine that streams binary-encoded frames via WebSockets to HTML5 Canvas for ultra-low latency 30 FPS playback. It transforms video into pure typographic canvas content, enabling real-time CSS filters, low-bandwidth zero-GPU operation on constrained devices, and seamless integration with lightweight LLMs for AI processing. Python/FastAPI backend uses OpenCV and NumPy for decoding and mapping; vanilla JS frontend handles rendering. Supports multiple color modes, adaptive codecs, audio sync, playlists, YouTube, and webcam streaming. Ideal for interactive web media, embedded systems, and low-resource environments without video elements.

repos.description: 🌩️ Serverless 自托管的文件管理与文本分享工具/网盘，支持多存储聚合管理和WebDAV 服务挂载。兼容 S3、WebDAV、OneDrive、Google Drive、Telegram、HF、GitHub 等。内置   Markdown 编辑器、30+文件格式预览。支持 Cloudflare Workers 或 Docker 部署。
repos.summary_zh: CloudPaste 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Serverless 自托管网盘，核心价值在于多云存储聚合管理与零运维部署。支持 S3、OneDrive、Google Drive 等 30+ 存储后端，提供统一 WebDAV 挂载。内置 Vditor Markdown 编辑器与 30+ 文件格式预览，实现个人知识库管理与团队协作。通过边缘计算实现全球加速，Docker 部署提供本地灵活性。
repos.summary_en: CloudPaste is a Serverless self-hosted cloud storage built on Cloudflare Workers, aggregating 30+ storage backends including S3, OneDrive, and Google Drive with unified WebDAV mounting. It features a Vditor Markdown editor, 30+ file format previews, and edge computing acceleration across 300+ global nodes. Offering zero-maintenance deployment via Workers or Docker, it serves as an ideal solution for personal knowledge management and team collaboration.

repos.summary_zh: Grok2API 基于 FastAPI 构建 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持聊天补全、图像编辑、视频生成及 Anthropic 接口。核心亮点包括多账号池管理、流式输出、工具调用、本地缓存与自动维护。提供 Docker 一键部署（含防 Cloudflare 方案）、内置 Admin 后台与 WebUI，适用于 AI 应用集成与多模态内容生成。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based Grok gateway exposing web capabilities via OpenAI-compatible APIs for chat, image editing, video generation, and Anthropic endpoints. Key highlights: multi-account pooling, streaming, tool calling, local caching, auto-maintenance. Offers Docker deployment with anti-CF options, admin panel, and WebUIs. Ideal for AI app integration and multimodal tasks.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Pages 和 Next.js 的 Serverless 图床服务。利用 Cloudflare 免费额度实现无限存储且零成本运营，无需自备服务器和域名。集成内容审核 API 自动屏蔽不良图片，提供完整的后台管理系统，支持访问统计、黑白名单管控，并可配置 Telegram 机器人实时通知。
repos.summary_en: A Serverless image hosting service built on Cloudflare Pages and Next.js. Offers unlimited storage at zero cost within Cloudflare's free tier, eliminating the need for self-hosted servers and domains. Features automated content moderation API for inappropriate images, a full-featured admin panel with access analytics, IP/referer whitelisting/blacklisting, and configurable Telegram bot notifications.

repos.description: 【零费用】一个让人呼吸顺畅的 Telegram 双向私聊机器人 🤖 / [Zero Cost] A Smooth-Operating Two-Way Private Messaging Telegram Bot 🤖
repos.summary_zh: Open Wegram Bot 是基于 Cloudflare Worker/Vercel 的 Telegram 双向私聊机器人，实现零成本、无服务器、无数据库的消息中转。采用无状态架构，支持 GitHub/Vercel 等多平台一键部署，无需绑定域名即可运行。适用于个人消息代理、轻量级客服等场景，提供稳定可靠的双向通信能力，是 LivegramBot 的免费替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Open Wegram Bot is a Telegram two-way private messaging bot built on Cloudflare Worker/Vercel, enabling zero-cost, serverless, database-free message forwarding. Featuring stateless architecture, it supports one-click deployment via GitHub/Vercel/Deno/Netlify without custom domain binding. Designed for personal message proxy and lightweight customer service, it provides stable bidirectional communication as a free alternative to LivegramBot with multi-bot support and encrypted security tokens for reliable operation.

repos.description: Selfhost web archiving and sharing service.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare 的免费网页归档服务，通过浏览器插件将页面保存为单文件 HTML，利用 Worker+D1+R2 全栈方案实现低成本存储与检索。集成 AI 自动标签分类、文件夹管理与阅读模式，支持移动端适配，提供完整的归档、搜索与分享功能，适合个人知识沉淀。
repos.summary_en: Web Archive is a free, serverless web archiving and sharing service built entirely on Cloudflare's platform. It captures webpages as single-file HTML through a browser extension and stores them using Cloudflare D1 database and R2 storage via Workers. The platform features AI-powered automatic tag classification, folder organization, reading mode, mobile responsiveness, and searchable archives. Leveraging Cloudflare's generous free tier, it provides a cost-effective, scalable solution for personal knowledge management and digital content preservation.

repos.description: Grok2API (Cloudflare Workers) one-click deploy with auto D1+KV provisioning
repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastAPI 重构的 Grok AI 代理 API，全面适配最新 Web 调用格式。支持流式/非流式对话、图像生成与深度思考，内置号池并发与自动负载均衡机制。提供 Cloudflare Workers 无服务器部署方案，集成 D1 数据库与 KV 存储。具备可视化后台管理、自动注册、Token 状态智能判定等企业级功能，实现多端部署一致性。
repos.summary_en: FastAPI-based proxy API for Grok AI, fully adapted to the latest web calling format. Supports streaming/non-streaming conversations, image generation/editing, and deep thinking with built-in account pool concurrency and auto load balancing. Offers Cloudflare Workers serverless deployment with D1 database and KV storage integration. Features visual admin panel, auto-registration with Turnstile solver, intelligent token status detection, and consistent behavior across local, Docker, and serverless deployments.

repos.summary_zh: AegisFlow 是本地运行的 GLM Coding 支付运营后台，支持多账号导入、套餐同步、腾讯验证码自动 OCR 识别与链路处理、预览下单签单生成二维码及定时任务启动。基于 FastAPI 后端与 Node.js 构建，集成内置 Python 代理池，实现全自动化支付流程，适合本地多账号管理和运营效率提升。
repos.summary_en: AegisFlow is a locally running payment operations backend for GLM Coding, supporting multi-account import/sync, automatic Tencent captcha OCR recognition and processing chains, order preview/signing for QR code generation, and scheduled task launching. Built with FastAPI backend and Node.js, featuring built-in Python proxy pool for fully automated payment workflows, ideal for local multi-account management and operational efficiency.

repos.description: A Powerful Serverless Uptime Monitoring & Status Page on Cloudflare's Edge Network
repos.summary_zh: Uptimer是基于Cloudflare边缘网络的无服务器运行时间监控与状态页面系统。支持HTTP/TCP探测、故障事件管理、维护窗口、Webhook通知（Discord/Slack等）及管理后台，零运维部署于Workers+Pages+D1，实现实时状态展示与告警。
repos.summary_en: Uptimer is a serverless uptime monitoring and status page running on Cloudflare's edge network. It offers HTTP/TCP probes, incident management, maintenance windows, webhook alerts (Discord/Slack/etc.), and an admin dashboard, all deployed zero-ops via Workers + Pages + D1 for real-time status and notifications.

repos.description: OpenAI-compatible Web Chat API proxy with GPT, Grok, Gemini account management and Docker self-hosting
repos.summary_zh: webchat2api 将 ChatGPT Web、Grok/xAI Web 与 Gemini Web 逆向封装为 OpenAI 兼容及 Gemini 原生 API 代理，支持多账号池管理、文生文/文生图、tier 感知调度与 Docker 一键自托管。提供 FastAPI 后端与 Next.js 管理后台，覆盖账号导入、代理配置、内容过滤、云备份及图片存储，适合个人学习与私有化部署场景。
repos.summary_en: webchat2api wraps ChatGPT Web, Grok/xAI Web and Gemini Web into OpenAI-compatible and Gemini native API proxies, with multi-account pools, text/image generation, tier-aware routing and Docker self-hosting. Features FastAPI backend plus Next.js admin UI for account management, proxies, content filtering, cloud backup and image storage—ideal for personal research and private deployments.

repos.description: spoo.me is an open-source & API first link management infra
repos.summary_zh: spoo.me 是一个开源、API 优先的短链接管理服务，提供自定义 slug（含 emoji）、密码保护、点击限制等高级功能。其核心亮点在于强大的分析能力，支持地理位置、设备、流量模式、引荐来源和机器人检测的多维度统计，并提供 CSV/JSON/XLSX/XML 数据导出。无需注册即可使用，支持自托管，完全免费且无功能限制，适合需要私有化部署或集成短链能力的开发者和企业。
repos.summary_en: spoo.me is an open-source, API-first URL shortening infrastructure offering advanced features like custom slugs (including emojis), password protection, and click limits. Its core strength lies in comprehensive analytics covering geographic distribution, device breakdown, traffic patterns, referrer tracking, and bot detection, with multi-format data export (CSV/JSON/XLSX/XML). Requiring no registration, it provides completely free unlimited usage with self-hosting capability. Ideal for developers and enterprises needing private deployment or integrated link management with detailed click insights.

repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT订阅支付链路自动化研究项目，聚焦支付流程（直卡/PayPal BA/hCaptcha）的工程实现与代理对齐。基于FastAPI后端核心引擎与React前端面板，支持多代理池与接码对接，仅供学习研究使用。
repos.summary_en: Research project on automating ChatGPT subscription payment chains, covering card binding, PayPal BA flows and hCaptcha handling. Built with FastAPI backend engines and React frontend panel, integrating multi-proxy pools and SMS services for study purposes only.

repos.description: 基于 FastAPI 重构的 Grok2API，适配最新的Web调用格式，支持流式对话、图像生成、图像编辑、联网搜索、视频生成、深度思考，支持号池并发调用和自动负载均衡。
repos.summary_zh: Tomiya233/grok2api 将 xAI 的 Grok 大模型封装为 OpenAI API 兼容接口，基于 FastAPI 构建。核心亮点包括：异步流式处理架构确保高并发性能，智能号池管理与负载均衡机制最大化调用稳定性，自动缓存解决资源链接 403 限制，提供完整的管理界面与统计监控。适用于需要将 Grok 集成至现有 AI 应用或构建高可用 Grok 服务的开发者。
repos.summary_en: Tomiya233/grok2api wraps xAI's Grok model into OpenAI API-compatible interfaces using FastAPI. Key features include: asynchronous streaming architecture for high concurrency, intelligent token pool management with auto load balancing, automatic caching to bypass 403 restrictions, and comprehensive admin dashboard with statistics. Enables developers to integrate Grok into existing AI applications or build highly available Grok services with enterprise-grade reliability.

repos.description: An AI-assisted newsroom workflow system for event tracking, evidence organization, approval chains, correction handling, and post-publication monitoring.
repos.summary_zh: NewsFlow 是一款 AI 辅助的新闻编辑室工作流系统，专注于新闻生产中高成本、高责任的中间流程。系统通过 AI 智能体实现线索归并、证据结构化、风险审查、签发审批和发布后监测，建立完整的人机协同审核机制。采用 FastAPI+React 技术栈，支持自托管和二次开发，为新闻机构提供可审计、可追溯的数字化协作平台。
repos.summary_en: NewsFlow is an AI-assisted newsroom workflow system focusing on the high-cost, high-responsibility intermediate processes of news production. It employs AI agents to handle lead clustering, evidence structuring, risk assessment, approval chains, and post-publication monitoring, establishing a comprehensive human-in-the-loop review mechanism. Built with FastAPI+React stack, it supports self-hosting and secondary development, providing news organizations with an auditable, traceable digital collaboration platform for editorial governance and fact-checking workflows.

repos.description: 极简 Cloudflare Worker，接收私人域名邮件并提供 HTTP API 读取
repos.summary_zh: ni-mail 是一个极简 Cloudflare Worker，通过 Email Routing 接收私人域名邮件并提供 HTTP API 读取。使用 KV 存储最多 50 封邮件，postal-mime 解析为结构化 JSON，支持 API Key 鉴权和多自定义域名，附件仅存 metadata。无需数据库、前端或 JWT，部署简单，适合自动化脚本获取邮件内容，实现轻量级邮件集成。
repos.summary_en: ni-mail is a minimalist Cloudflare Worker that receives private domain emails via Cloudflare Email Routing and exposes them through a simple HTTP API. It stores up to 50 emails in KV, parses them with postal-mime into structured JSON, supports API key auth and multiple custom domains, and keeps only attachment metadata. No database, frontend or JWT needed; ideal for automation scripts fetching emails in a lightweight, serverless setup.

repos.description: 利用Deno提供的服务进行代理中转
repos.summary_zh: DenoProxy是基于Deno运行时构建的轻量级动态代理服务，核心能力在于通过URL参数实时配置代理目标，并将/proxy路径请求无缝转发至指定后端。项目采用Deno原生HTTP服务器与KV存储，支持本地运行与Deno Deploy云部署双模式，适用于API调试、跨域请求代理及开发环境网络中转等场景，具备配置灵活、部署极简的技术特征。
repos.summary_en: DenoProxy is a lightweight dynamic proxy service built on Deno runtime, featuring real-time target configuration via URL parameters and seamless request forwarding for /proxy paths. Leveraging Deno's native HTTP server and KV storage, it supports both local execution and Deno Deploy cloud deployment. Ideal for API debugging, cross-origin request proxying, and development environment network tunneling, it delivers flexible configuration and minimal deployment overhead.

repos.description: Panel.NA1 持续赚取金币
repos.summary_zh: 该项目利用 HuggingFace Spaces 免费托管服务，实现 Panel.NA1 平台的 24/7 自动化挂机赚金币。核心特性包括每分钟自动签到、Cookie 自动刷新、Web 监控面板及抗休眠保活机制，支持 Telegram 通知。零成本部署，适用于个人资源获取与无服务器自动化技术实践，通过反代解决网络限制。
repos.summary_en: This project leverages HuggingFace Spaces free hosting to automate 24/7 coin farming on Panel.NA1 platform. Key features include automatic check-in every minute, cookie auto-refresh, web monitoring dashboard, anti-idle keep-alive mechanism, and Telegram notifications via reverse proxy. Zero-cost deployment suits personal resource acquisition and serverless automation learning, effectively overcoming network restrictions while maintaining persistent operation through external health checks.

repos.description: TypeScript SDK for the NitroPing audit log — batching client, error capture, Hono/Express/Nitro adapters, and GenAI cost tracing.
repos.summary_zh: nitroping-sdk 是 nitroping.dev 平台的官方多语言客户端库，支持 TypeScript、Swift、Python、Go、Kotlin、PHP 等语言，封装 REST API 实现设备令牌注册（APNs/FCM/Web Push）、多渠道通知发送（推送、邮件、SMS、Slack）、定向/定时/循环推送、Web Push 订阅与 UI 组件、内置收件箱及 Webhook 验证。适用于移动/Web 应用与服务器端通知集成，提供统一 API、公私钥认证和幂等性支持，实现跨平台一致体验。
repos.summary_en: nitroping-sdk offers official client libraries for the nitroping.dev platform across TypeScript, Swift, Python, Go, Kotlin, and PHP. It wraps the REST API for device token registration (APNs/FCM/Web Push), multi-channel notifications (push, email, SMS, Slack), targeted/scheduled/recurring sends, Web Push subscriptions with UI widgets, in-app inbox, and webhook verification. Ideal for mobile/web apps and servers needing unified, secure cross-platform notification delivery with public/secret key auth and idempotency.

repos.description: Turn a private Hugging Face repo into your own cloud storage service.
repos.summary_zh: Hugging Cloud 将私有 Hugging Face 仓库转化为自托管云存储服务，专为 AI 团队管理模型与数据集设计。基于 FastAPI+Next.js 全栈架构，提供 RBAC 权限控制、可恢复上传和签名链接安全访问。Docker 容器化部署，支持 SQLite/Postgres 和 Redis，兼顾轻量便捷与生产级扩展能力。
repos.summary_en: Hugging Cloud transforms private Hugging Face repositories into self-hosted cloud storage services, purpose-built for AI teams managing models and datasets. Built on a modern FastAPI+Next.js stack, it delivers enterprise-grade features including RBAC access control, resumable uploads, and cryptographically signed download links. Docker containerized deployment supports both SQLite for lightweight use and Postgres/Redis for production scalability, enabling seamless integration into existing AI infrastructure while maintaining data privacy and access governance.
